decision: Approve the scene-media convention for decorative scene media.

evidence.interpretation: The owner approved the naming convention in gate 3 of the Hero v0.1 plan. The whole-file plan SHA-256 is 11906914c6cc8b6f5eddade2a14a3f3415061727408e4e03c34e09901de8eb82; the exact entry text is in section 5. Not native review authority.

convention.name: media
convention.meaning: A passive, decorative media or 3D slot of a scene organism, supplied by the consumer.
convention.whenToUse: Supply optional decorative scene media such as an Isotipo3D or an image that carries no unique meaning.
convention.avoid: Do not use for thumbnails, interactive content, effect selectors or Radix asChild composition.
